title: Open Play Anxiety
style: chill electro pop, 102 BPM, dreamy synth pads, soft 808 sub, female vocal, breathy harmonies, anxious-but-hopeful, modern alt-pop, builds to release
lyrics:
[Intro]
Stack the paddle, take a number
Pretend you're not nervous, pretend you're not nervous

[Verse 1]
Twenty paddles in a rack like a queue at the bank
I'm a five-month player and the rack is full of rank
Four-ohs talking shop about a tournament last week
Three of them are coaches and one of them is sleek

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't be the slowest one
Don't be the loudest one
Just be the one who shows up
And keeps showing up

[Chorus]
Open play anxiety
Open play anxiety
Smile at the stranger, take the court with three
Open play anxiety, set me free
Open play anxiety

[Verse 2]
Got partnered with a four-five who was kind to me
Said relax your shoulders, watch the geometry
We lost eleven to seven but I found my feet
And the next four games I was harder to beat

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't be the slowest one
Don't be the loudest one
Just be the one who shows up
And keeps showing up

[Chorus]
Open play anxiety
Open play anxiety
Smile at the stranger, take the court with three
Open play anxiety, set me free
Open play anxiety

[Bridge]
The rack doesn't bite
The strangers become friends
Every awkward Tuesday
Eventually ends

[Outro]
Stack the paddle, take a number
You belong here, you belong here
